Deagle 44 357.info:
Load your Desert Eagle L5 with .357 Magnum.
This ammunition makes your weapon more easier to control in exchange for less damage, but you gain better accuracy and reload speed.

Uzi .41 Conversion.info:
Locks to Semi-Auto.
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .41 Action Express in a custom 20 round magazine. Perfect for seige missions.
Use this ammo to punch through cover, and land harder hits to take down the opposition.

Groza 5.56 Conversion.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.56x45mm NATO. It never went into production due to project funding issues. Improves weapon accuracy drastically but reduces overall damage and range.

CS/LR-4A .308 Winchester.info: Rechambers your Jinhanian sniper rifle in .308 Winchester, increasing damage range, bullet speed and penetration but also recoil and cuts down your reserves. Slower cycling rate!

G28 308 Conversion.info: Load your M28 with .308 Winchester, turning it into the civilian M28Z model. Uses a lower-capacity magazine but packs a stronger punch while improving overall handling somewhat.

Mac10 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MAC-10 into 9x19mm!
Shoots significantly faster. Reduces recoil and improves bullet speed but weaker damage!

MCX Spear 7.62x51.info: Converts the MCX SPEAR into firing traditional 7.62x51mm NATO. Increases overall damage to perform like a true battle rifle but lowers fire rate, bullet speed and penetration due to the slower bullet!

UMP .40 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-40.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

Saiga 220 Russian Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.6x39mm, a 5.6mm projectile from necked down 7.62x39mm brass!
Excellent bullet speed with improved damage falloff, very lethal headshot damage and more penetration than 7.62x39mm but lowers your close range performance!

.338 Norma.info: Loads your Arctic Warfare with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it retains your one shot limb range while improving your firing speed!

SASS 358 Conversion.info:
An alternate ammo type for the SASS 308.
 The .358 Winchester cartridge gives your SASS weapon more power close up towards an enemies torso, trading long range performance. A perfect panic backup.

TAR Duplex Ammo.info: Specialty Colt 5.56x45 ammo stuffed with 2 bullets stacked on eachother. Splits the stats, and uses a smaller magazine than normal. More powerful than you'd expect, and reloads swiftly.

R10/22 .17 HMR.info:
Converts your R10/22 to fire .17 HMR, a wildcat cartridge that is weaker than .22 LR but has significantly higher speed!
Worse penetration performance resulting in terrible torso damage but can one shot to the head up close and has massively more muzzle velocity!

MK11 500 Conversion.info:
Convert your MK11 to fire .500 Phantom. Made specifically for the AR10 platform.
Very slow bullet, increased recoil, but with a dramatic power increase.

R10/22 Rat Shot.info:
Loads your R10/22 with small .22 Rat Shot bullets, each firing 10 pellets with little spread!
Powerful up close, especially to the head but has very poor muzzle velocity, penetration and ranged performance!

R10/22 Full-Auto Conv.info:
A dubiously legal conversion kit that lets you fire full-auto!
I'm not sure why you would want this, but it is an option.

SA58 .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .45 ACP.
Heavily modifies performance befitting of the pistol caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with an aftermarket modified Thompson 50-round drum.

SKORP 9x18mm Conversion.info:
Load your Skorpion with 9x18mm Makarov.
Loading from a 30 round magazine, you lose a small amount of close range performance with reduced damage in range while retaining the same range profile. Higher bullet velocity and a higher firerate.

SHORTY .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .45 ACP.
Heavily modifies performance befitting of the pistol caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with an aftermarket modified Thompson 50-round drum.

SA58 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with standard issue 30-round STANAG Magazinse.

.338 Norma (TRG-42).info: Loads your TRG with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

AR 25-45 Conversion.info:
Loads your AR-15 with .25-45 Sharps.
 This uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

GSP Rat Shot.info: Aiming? You don't need to do that. Just spitball tiny, almost harmless pellets at people until they ask you to stop. It cannot even properly cycle rounds, forcing you to manually cycle the bullets each shot.

K14 .308 Winchester.info:
Load your K14 with .308 Winchester.
Fitted with a 5 round magazine, the K14 gains more favourable sniper traits with additional reload speed, but less rounds are carried.

Deagle 50 357.info: A .44 wildcat round developed using a necked-down .50 AE cartridge for use in the Desert Eagle XIX. Stronger ballistic performance at range at the cost of some close-range power.
